name: Izawa Miyu
source: The protagonist of the game. She was recently recruited by "Studio Yo" to work as a clothes designer. Although she appears to be a normal girl, she possesses an extremely keen perception, which grants her the ability to read other people, as well as foretelling when something bad is about to happen.
